It is not inadmissible to think of an epoch
Â . . .
not too far distant, when humanity, to ensure its survival, will find itself reduced to desisting from any further âmakingâ of history.
âMircea Eliade
T
he earthquake shook us awake at 4:31 in the morning. We hurried into a closet while, for fifteen seconds, it finished its business and the car alarms down on Third and California began their complaint. When we emerged, the night sky greeted us through a crack in the wall and chunks of plaster sat smack on the Apple keyboard. The cat had fled.
Out on the street, the hanging dust of rendered Sheetrock mixed with the scent of potted plants and, for those of us standing in our nightclothes, a dose of adrenaline improved the sense of awe. Suddenly the inhuman forces of the raw earth had struck us, forces that lift mountains and sink cities. And suddenly there was a rip in time, a twenty-heartbeat glimpse into the equally inhuman roll of ages where continents join and break apart.
Thirty miles north of our Santa Monica apartment, Oat Mountain had risen fifteen inches and moved six inches to one side. That mountain sits in southern Californiaâs Transverse Ranges, which began their rise from the sea about 5Â million years ago, having first been caught, some 15Â million years earlier, between tectonic plates that spun them clockwise so they now sit at right angles to the coast. The geology of the Transverse Ranges consists largely of granite from the Mesozoic Eraâ66Â to 252Â million years agoâwith some even earlier Precambrian material, at least 1.6Â billion years old.
These are large numbers. They belong to the calculus of deep time as introduced to the world by British scientists in the mid-nineteenth centuryânamely, the preeminent geologist of the age, Charles Lyell, and Charles Darwin, who borrowed Lyellâs unbounded temporality and used it to underpin his theory of evolution.
Long before he formulated that theory, Darwin himself had witnessed what he called âthe forces which slowly and by little starts uplift continents.â The year was 1835 and Darwin was near
ing the end of a five-year journey around the world aboard the British surveying ship
the HMSÂ
Beagle.
In Chile, he was onshore one February day taking a nap when the ground began to rock. The quake lasted two minutes; its only local effect was to make Darwin âalmost giddy.â
Nearly two weeks later, he arrived in ConcepciÃ³n to find a completely ruined city. After offering an inventory of all that was lost, Darwin, ever the student geologist, noted that âthe land round the Bay of Concepcion was upraised two or three feetâ and that on the nearby island of Santa MarÃ­a they found âmussel-shells
still adhering to the rocks,
ten feet above high-water mark.â Later that month, Darwin climbed high into the Andes, where he found âshells which were once crawling on the bottom of the sea, now standing nearly 14,000 feet above its level.â It had taken about twenty-five million years for those shells to reach that height.
For several years now, I have been reading these early theorists, thinking that their vision of geological and evolutionary time might give me a context for understanding not just the age of mountains but something more current. Itâs one thing to hear of the millions of years it took the Andes to rise; itâs quite another to hear that, in mere centuries, the oceans may reach levels of acidity not seen in 300 million years, or that the earth is the hottest it has been in the past 125,000 years. These days, geological forces, formerly the stuff of earthquakes and volcanoes, have escaped the confines of deep time to present themselves daily, winter, spring, summer, and fall.
It is on this other end of the scale of timeâin seasons rather than eonsâthat my own interest in natural science began and where today it finds its focus and concern. As a child and to this day, one of my deepest pleasures has come from walking farm fields and alpine meadows, watching for butterflies, a pursuit that takes on a formal touch each year when, in early July, I join the annual Concord, Massachusetts, butterfly count. Fifteen or twenty naturalists, most of us amateurs, gather and split into several teams to search a set list of local fields and woods. My group always begins in nearby Sudbury, where thereâs a colony of Appalachian Browns, not a rare butterfly but one found only in wet woods, swamps, and bottomlands, a habitat I would have done well to read about before my first visit, when I waded into a field of tall sedges and spent the

data.article_summary: 亚马逊的碳排放量在2024年上升了6%，达到6825万吨二氧化碳当量，主要原因是数据中心建设和配送燃料消耗增加。数据中心建设需求激增，尤其为支持人工智能应用，导致电力和建筑材料（如混凝土和钢材）的使用大幅上升。尽管亚马逊及其他科技巨头（如Alphabet、Meta、微软）正投资于无碳核能，但电力需求的增加也促使部分地区重新使用天然气和煤炭发电。亚马逊承认需加快发展无碳能源，以满足技术需求并减少碳排放。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：数据中心（DCs）的能源消耗及其环境影响

不同观点：
• [blibble] 认为，减少个人层面的能源消耗（如减少牛肉消费、减少驾驶和出国度假）并不会真正改善环境，因为大型科技公司（如亚马逊）仍在扩建数据中心，最终只是让这些公司高层（如贝索斯）更加富裕，而普通人变得无关紧要。

• [breakyerself] 指出，能源需求的增长是正常的，当前的环境问题更多是由于长期政策失败导致的，而不是单纯由个人或企业的行为所造成。

• [tootie] 提出一个技术性建议，询问为什么数据中心不采用地源热泵进行气候控制，因为这种方法的运营成本最低，可能有助于减少能源消耗。

• [JCM9] 批评亚马逊在努力让公众相信其在人工智能领域没有落后的同时，悄悄停止了关于减少温室气体排放的讨论，暗示公司在环境承诺上的虚伪。

• [wskinner] 认为，更高的能源消耗实际上能带来更高的生活水平和更好的社会成果，暗示能源使用和生活质量之间存在正相关关系。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点之一是个人行为与企业行为在环境影响中的相对重要性。[blibble] 和 [breakyerself] 对此有不同看法，前者认为企业行为更关键，后者则强调政策失败是主要原因。

• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是[tootie]提出的技术解决方案，即地源热泵在数据中心中的应用潜力，这可能为减少数据中心的能源消耗提供一种实际可行的方法。

• 亚马逊公司在环境保护和商业竞争中的表现也是一个讨论焦点，[JCM9] 的评论指向了该公司在环保承诺上的选择性沉默和市场竞争中的策略。

• 最后，关于能源消耗与生活水平之间的关系也存在不同看法，[wskinner] 的观点与环保减排的常见论述形成对比，强调了能源使用的积极面。

Amazon’s Emissions Climbed 6% in 2024 on Data Center Buildout
Amazon’s Emissions Climbed 6% in 2024 on Data Center Buildout
The e-commerce giant emitted 68 tons of carbon dioxide equivalent last year, up 6% from 2024.
Matt Day
,
Bloomberg News
July 17, 2025
1 Min
Read
Image: Bloomberg
(Bloomberg) -- Amazon’s carbon emissions rose for the first time in three years in 2024, driven by data center construction and fuel consumption by its delivery providers.
The world’s largest online retailer emitted 68.25 million metric tons of carbon dioxide equivalent last year, up 6% from the prior year, Amazon said in its annual
sustainability report
, which was published on Wednesday. The company’s emissions last year were up by a third since Amazon pledged in 2019 to eliminate them by 2040.
The company and its high-tech rivals are spending heavily on data centers to power artificial intelligence applications, which require plenty of concrete and steel, two materials that use a lot of energy to produce.
Environmental watchdogs have raised the alarm as the AI data center boom helped supercharge electricity demand, and, in some areas, breathed new life into
natural gas
and
coal-fired power
. Those energy sources had fallen out of favor among tech companies in recent years as they pledged to find cleaner sources and zero out their impact on carbon emissions.
Amazon and fellow data-center giants Alphabet, Meta Platforms, and Microsoft have also signed deals to scoop up carbon-free nuclear power in the coming years.
Amazon’s emissions from purchased electricity rose 1% last year, the first increase since the company began reporting the figure in 2019, “in part due to the higher electricity usage required to support advanced technologies.”
Related:
Data Center Emissions: Virginia, Texas, California Top CO2 Chart
“This underscores why it’s important to scale carbon-free energy sources to continue to deliver the advanced technologies our customers need,” Amazon said in the report.

data.title: The great AI delusion is falling apart
data.author: walterbell
data.article_summary: 文章探讨了人工智能（AI）在实际应用中的表现与公众期望之间的差距。一项随机对照试验显示，尽管程序员认为使用AI工具能提高20%的编码速度，但实际上他们反而慢了19%。这种自我欺骗的现象广泛存在，许多人愿意相信AI能带来巨大生产力提升，尽管现实往往相反。多项研究和调查表明，AI项目的投资回报率低，失败率高，且经常无法完成任务。企业和媒体夸大AI的能力，部分是为了削减成本和提升股价。专家指出，当前的AI模型不够成熟，无法自主实现复杂商业目标，且存在推理能力不足等问题。文章认为，公众对AI的盲目信仰源于误导性宣传和自我欺骗。

主要讨论点：对论文中警示的误解是否应该被公开传播

不同观点：
• 一方认为将论文中明确警示的误解进行公开传播（如刊登在报纸上）是不妥的。这可能导致公众对研究的错误理解，从而产生误导性的结论。该观点强调应尊重作者的提醒，避免误用研究结果。

• 另一方可能认为这种公开传播是有趣且无伤大雅的，甚至可能认为这是一种对研究的“酷”的表达方式。这种观点似乎不太在意误解可能带来的负面影响，或者认为读者有能力识别这些误解。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于是否应该对学术研究的结果进行严格筛选和正确解读后再向公众传播。一方担心误解会引发错误的信息传播，而另一方则可能认为这种误解不一定是负面的，甚至可以引发更多讨论。

• 例子提到“论文中警示的误解”被刊登在报纸上，暗示媒体在传播科学研究结果时的责任和影响。这可能反映出对媒体科学素养的关注以及对学术成果大众化的讨论。

Andrew Orlowski
14 July 2025 11:00am BST
Is the secret of artificial intelligence that we have to kid ourselves, like an audience at a magic show?
Some fascinating new research suggests that self-deception plays a key role in whether AI is perceived to be a success or a dud.
In a randomised controlled trial – the first of its kind – experienced computer programmers could use AI tools to help them write code. What the trial revealed was a vast amount of self-deception.
“The results surprised us,” research lab METR reported. “Developers thought they were 20pc faster with AI tools, but they were actually 19pc
slower
when they had access to AI than when they didn’t.”
In reality, using AI made them
less
productive: they were wasting more time than they had gained. But what is so interesting is how they swore blind that the opposite was true.
If you think AI is helping you in your job, perhaps it’s because you
want
to believe that it works.
Since OpenAI’s ChatGPT was thrown open to the general public in late 2022, pundits have been forecasting huge productivity gains from deploying AI. They hope that it will supercharge growth and boost GDP. This has become the default opinion in high-status policy circles.
But all this techno-optimism is founded on delusion. The “lived experience” of using real tools in the real world paints a very different picture.
The past few days have felt like a turning point, as the reluctance of pointing out the emperor’s new clothes diminishes.
“I build AI agents for a living, it’s what I do for my clients,” wrote one Reddit user. “The gap between the hype and what’s actually happening on the ground is turning into a canyon”
AI isn’t reliable enough to do the job promised. According to an IBM survey of 2,000 chief executives, three out of four AI projects have failed to show a return on investment, which is a remarkably high failure rate.
Don’t hold your breath for a white-collar automation revolution either: AI agents fail to complete the job successfully about 65 to 70pc of the time, according to a study by Carnegie Mellon University and Salesforce.
The analyst firm Gartner Group has concluded that “current models do not have the maturity and agency to autonomously achieve complex business goals or follow nuanced instructions over time.” Gartner’s head of AI research Erick Brethenoux says: “AI is not doing its job today and should leave us alone”.
It’s no wonder that companies such as Klarna, which laid off staff in 2023 confidently declaring that AI could do their jobs, are hiring humans again.
This is extraordinary, and we can only have reached this point because of a historic self-delusion. People will even pledge their faith to AI working well despite their own subjective experience to the contrary, the AI critic Professor Gary Marcus noted last week.
“Recognising that it sucks in your own speciality, but imagining that it is somehow fabulous in domains you are less familiar with”, is something he calls “ChatGPT blindness”.
Much of the news is misleading. Firms are simply using AI as an excuse for retrenchment. Cost reduction is the big story in business at the moment.
Globally, President Trump’s erratic behaviour has induced caution, while in the UK,
business confidence is at “historically depressed levels”
, according to the Institute of Directors, reeling from Reeves’s autumn taxes. Attributing those lay-offs to technology is simply clever PR, and helps boost the share price.
So why does the faith in AI remain so strong?
The dubious hype doesn’t help. Every few weeks a new AI model appears, and smashes industry benchmarks. xAI’s Grok 4 did just that last week. But these are deceptive and simply provide more confirmation bias.
“Every single one of them has been wide of that mark. And not one has resolved hallucinations, alignment issues or boneheaded errors,” says Marcus.
Not only is generative AI unreliable, but it can’t reason, as a recent demonstration showed: OpenAI’s latest ChatGPT4o model was beaten by an 8-bit Atari home games console made in 1977.
“Reality is the ultimate benchmark for AI,” explained Chomba Bupe, a Zambian AI developer, last week. “You not going to declare that you have built intelligence by beating toy benchmarks … What’s the point of getting say 90pc on some physics benchmarks yet be unable to do any real physics?” he asked.

data.title: Rising Graduate Joblessness Is Mainly Affecting Men
data.author: andrewstetsenko
data.article_summary:
文章主要讨论了两个经济现象。首先，美国年轻男性大学毕业生的失业率在过去一年中从不到5%上升至7%，与未获得学位的同龄人失业率持平，而女性毕业生的失业率没有明显变化。尽管初步推测这可能与人工智能导致的就业岗位减少有关，但数据表明，入门级编程和软件开发岗位的招聘正在回升，早期的编码职业就业情况甚至优于人工智能时代之前。

其次，文章分析了加州快餐行业最低工资从16美元提高到20美元的影响。研究显示，这一政策使得加州快餐行业的工资上涨约8%，但就业人数相对其他地区减少了2%到4%，相当于减少了18,000个工作岗位。

文章还提到其他相关研究，探讨了最低工资政策对就业市场的影响以及大学毕业生失业率上升的现象。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：性别薪酬差距是否存在及其可能的解释

不同观点：
• [samfriedman] 认为，讨论各行业性别薪酬差距时，需要根据各行业中不同性别的比例进行标准化处理，否则数据可能不具备实际意义。这一观点强调了分析中需要考虑性别比例，以避免误导性结论。

• [PaulHoule] 提出，如果女性真的在相同工作下获得更低薪酬，雇主应该会倾向于雇佣更多女性以降低成本（进行套利）。该评论隐含的立场是对性别薪酬差距的存在表示怀疑，认为市场机制会自然纠正这种不平衡。

• [khelavastr] 认为，当前的意识提高和社会舆论偏向于支持女性，男性在这一过程中缺乏法律支持以获得公平。这一观点强调了男性可能在性别议题中面临不公正，暗示性别薪酬差距问题可能被过度简化或误解。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于性别薪酬差距是否真实存在及其背后的原因。一部分人质疑数据分析的准确性，另一部分人则从经济和法律角度提出不同看法。

• 评论中涉及的论据包括市场调节机制（如雇主套利）、性别比例标准化的重要性，以及社会和法律对不同性别的支持程度。

• 这些观点反映了在讨论性别薪酬差距问题时，存在对数据解读、市场调节能力及社会公正性的多角度思考。

Rising Graduate Joblessness Is Mainly Affecting Men. Will That Last?
John Burn-Murdoch
Financial Times
Date Posted:
July 18, 2025
Is Database:
Database
The unemployment rate for recent male college graduates (22–27) has risen from <5% to 7%. Recent male graduates “are now unemployed at the same rate as their non-graduate counterparts,” while the rate for their female peers is unchanged.
Share
Summary
Related
Topics
More
PDF
The unemployment rate for recent male graduates has risen steeply from less than 5% to 7% over the past 12 months. For young female graduates in the US, joblessness is unchanged over the same period, if not falling slightly. Most striking of all, recently graduated young men are now unemployed at the same rate as their non-graduate counterparts, completely erasing the college employability premium. At first glance, this lines up neatly with the theory that we’re looking at the leading edge of a wave of AI-driven job displacement. But drill down into sector-specific employment, and the evidence doesn’t seem to fit the narrative. The much-remarked-upon contraction in hiring entry-level programmers and software developers in the US has sharply reversed in recent months. In fact, relative to the pre-generative AI era, early-career coding employment is now tracking ahead of the rest of the economy.

Something Alarming Is Happening To The Job Market

Did California's Fast Food Minimum Wage Reduce Employment?
Jeffrey Clemens, Olivia Edwards and Jonathan Meer
National Bureau of Economic Research
Date Posted:
July 16, 2025
Is Database:
Database
The 2024 rise in CA’s minimum wage in fast food restaurants from $16 to $20 raised the sector’s wages ~8% and lowered its employment by 2 to 4% relative to the US sector overall, with an estimated loss of 18,000 CA fast food jobs. @jeffreypclemens
Share
Summary
Related
Topics
More
PDF
We analyze the effect of California's $20 fast food minimum wage [up from $16], which was enacted in September 2023 and went into effect in April 2024, on employment in the fast food sector. We document that AB 1228 increased wages substantially, with a roughly 8% increase in California’s fast food sector relative to the fast food sector elsewhere in the country. In unadjusted data from the Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages, we find that employment in California's fast food sector declined by 2.7% relative to employment in the fast food sector elsewhere in the United States from September 2023 through September 2024. In Figures 1b, 1c, and 1d, for which each series has been indexed relative to September 2023, the magnitude of the relative decline through late 2024 is readily observed from the graphs as being on the order of 2 to 4%. Indexing, detrending, and seasonally adjusting the data make the series more visually comparable but do not substantively alter the relative movements that underlie our regression estimates. Our median estimate translates into a loss of 18,000 jobs in California's fast food sector relative to the counterfactual.

data.author: Stwerner

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI在编程和软件开发中的应用及其影响

不同观点：
• **Tom_m**：认为AI应帮助开发者专注于高层次的设计和批判性思维，而非纠结于代码细节。他强调软件架构和设计模式的重要性，并指出掌握这些技能需要长时间的经验积累。
• **Nirvanatikku**：赞同文章观点，强调清晰表达问题对AI驱动开发的重要性。他分享了使用Repl.it等工具的积极体验，认为这些工具能提升开发效率，但也指出AI有时会偏离预期，需要人工干预。
• **Lordnacho**：享受AI辅助编程带来的便利，特别是减少了繁琐的编辑工作，提高了工作效率。他认为AI对有经验的开发者特别有帮助，但对新手的影响尚不明确。
• **Rmdashrfv**：指出AI在实现细节上的局限性，尤其是在非web领域的软件开发中。他认为AI的成功很大程度上依赖于开发者对实现细节的不关心，且很多项目因无法精确控制AI而失败。
• **Flatcircle**：认为AI是搜索技术的进化，只是一个工具，不会导致行业的存在危机。他强调聪明的人能利用工具做很多有趣的事情，但工具仍需人工操作。
• **D00mB0t**：以戏谑的方式提到利用AI在网络安全咨询方面赚钱的潜力。
• **Sgt101**：分享了在使用AI模型时的经验，指出在处理已知任务时效果较好，但在不熟悉的领域容易产生错误且难以纠正。
• **Schneems**：关注AI生成代码的质量和一致性问题，认为当前AI在将开放问题分解为可验证的具体步骤方面表现不佳，希望有更多控制权。
• **Gngoo**：认为自己已经掌握了利用AI高效开发的技巧，但难以传授给他人。他强调AI对开发效率的巨大提升，但指出多数开发者尚未接受这种新方式。
• **Asadotzler**：质疑AI在处理安全、国际化、可访问性等软件质量核心问题上的能力，认为业余开发者难以达到商业软件的标准，AI辅助开发方式可能阻碍行业成熟。
• **Divan**：强调阅读和理解代码的重要性，认为即使有AI辅助，开发者仍需保持对代码的清晰理解，以确保代码对其他开发者友好。
• **Saadatq**：提出“flex coding”的新概念，分享了利用AI在短时间内高效完成项目的个人经验，强调AI对生活工作平衡的积极影响。
• **Siliconc0w**：对AI开发的效果感到失望，认为AI指导可能影响下一代开发者的能力发展，并担心当前方法可能对行业产生负面影响。
• **Wiremine**：分享了对AI辅助开发的积极体验，认为这是一种新的方法论，可能导致一些热爱手工艺的开发者离开行业，但同时也会开启新的机会。

data.title: Adblockers stop publishers serving ads to (or even seeing) 1B web users
data.author: thm
data.article_summary: 根据Ad-Shield的报告，"暗流量"（即被严格广告拦截器隐藏的网页浏览量）在过去三年中增长了49%。这些拦截器屏蔽所有网站分析、白名单广告、请求允许广告的弹窗、cookie提示以及付费墙等。全球有9.76亿用户产生"暗流量"，占所有网络流量的18%，预计2026年将达到11亿用户。英国23%的网络流量为"暗流量"，涉及1600万用户。多数用户并未主动选择屏蔽广告，而是由第三方如雇主、教育机构或安全软件启用。最令用户反感的广告是预播视频广告，半数受访者表示其令人沮丧。报告强调，广告拦截已成主流，对出版商收入构成威胁。同时，新闻/媒体联盟宣布取缔绕过付费墙的12ft.io网站。业内人士指出，理解并应对这一变化对出版商至关重要。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：广告拦截器及其对广告技术（adtech）和内容发布者的影响

不同观点：
• [veeti] 认为广告拦截器并不会完全阻止流量测量，因为发布者仍然可以通过服务器端日志进行测量。问题在于发布者过度依赖容易被绕过的JavaScript跟踪器。
• [stop50] 反驳“未经用户同意的去货币化”的说法，指出使用广告拦截器是用户的选择，且广告变得令人厌烦和侵犯隐私，是用户采用广告拦截器的主要原因。
• [altairprime] 提到在没有广告拦截器的情况下，某些网站会弹出冗长的法律条款弹窗，迫使用户接受。
• [general1726] 分享个人经历，说明广告商的激进策略迫使他们使用广告拦截器，形成了恶性循环。
• [ethin] 表示对广告技术公司面临的困境感到满意，认为他们是咎由自取，广告拦截器是在阻止他们的不当行为。
• [3036e4] 使用NoScript来阻止大部分广告和跟踪脚本，并表示如果广告没有跟踪行为，可以接受。
• [musicale] 强调广告技术的激进和讨厌是用户采用广告拦截器的主要驱动因素，并指出安全风险也是原因之一。
• [D-Coder] 质疑如何测量所谓的“无法测量的流量”，并暗示广告技术公司可能有意高估这种流量。
• [southernplaces7] 对广告拦截器减少寄生数据采集表示满意，并直接对数据采集公司表示不满。
• [ok123456] 质疑“暗流量”的概念，将其与用户在电视上跳过广告的行为相比较。
• [bediger4000] 认为广告拦截器提高了网络安全性，是个人信息安全的一部分。
• [debarshri] 提醒用户注意随机安装的广告拦截器可能获取私人信息，并提出广告拦截器可以作为订阅管理平台的机会。

补充讨论：
• [pinum] 引用数据指出，大量用户通过广告了解并激活了硬广告拦截器。

争议焦点：
• 广告拦截器的使用是否经过用户同意，以及其对广告生态系统的影响。
• 广告技术公司和发布者是否应为激进广告策略导致的后果负责。
• “暗流量”概念的合理性和测量方法的有效性。

这些观点反映了广告拦截器在用户隐私、安全和广告生态系统中的复杂角色，以及各方对此的不同看法。

44627358.article_content:
AdGuard, a strict ad-blocker and privacy protection app. Picture: Shutterstock/mariakray
Web traffic that cannot be measured, and therefore monetised, by publishers has grown by 49% in the past three years, according to a new report.
The new study from adtech company Ad-Shield claims to be the first to comprehensively measure and explain the scale of “dark traffic”.
“Dark traffic” is defined as page views hidden to publishers by the strictest types of ad-blockers.
These block all on-site analytics, whitelisted adverts, ad-block walls that ask people to allow ads, cookie content pop-ups and registration walls or paywalls.
This differs from traffic coming via softer ad-blockers that still allow all or many of these monetisation options for publishers but hide the most aggressive advertising for users.
The report claims to have found 976 million users globally representing “dark traffic” across the web, totalling 18% of all web traffic. That’s up from 590 million in 2019.
It predicts that dark traffic will hit 1.1 billion users in 2026.
In the UK, the report found that 23% of web traffic is “dark”, representing 16 million users.
The report findings were based on a study of more than five billion “dark traffic” page views detected across Ad-Shield’s publisher network by its proprietary technology in 2024 and 2025, combined with a consumer survey of 2,616 respondents generating “dark” page views and some third-party data including previous industry estimates from 2019 to 2023, before Ad-Shield launched. Ad-Shield claims it can now detect and measure traffic that evades traditional ad-blocker detection tools.
The study discovered that the majority of users did not choose to block ads, with ad-blocking technology often activated by a third-party like their employer at a network level, their educational institution, security software they installed, or public Wi-Fi networks.
For example ad-blocking tech can be bundled with VPNs (virtual private networks that hide a web user’s location) and built into browsers like BRave and Duck Duck Go. There are also dedicated apps and cross-platform brands such as AdGuard which describes itself as “the world’s most advanced ad blocker” that can “even” block on Youtube.
Previously ad-blocking was mainly thought to be done through browser extensions added to the most-used browsers like Google Chrome and Mozilla Firefox.
Under half (48%) of the survey respondents said they were fully aware they were ad-blocking, while 12% were somewhat aware and 40% were unaware.
Of those who block ads (including those who did not actively choose to), almost a quarter (23%) said they prefer not to see ads while 6% said they wanted to remove the most annoying ads and 6% did it for privacy reasons so they could not be tracked.
The report found that one type of advert proved the most irritating to users and most likely to trigger them to download an ad-blocked: pre-roll video adverts, which half (51%) said they find disruptive or frustrating.
The greatest proportion of users who self-activated a hard ad-blocker found out about it through advertising (34%), followed by word of mouth (31%) and media/social media (16%).
The report said: “These insights align with our ecosystem observations: many ad-block developers now market their products aggressively via Google Ads and programmatic placements, reaching users at scale.
“For publishers, this underlines the importance of awareness — brutal ad-blockers are no longer fringe tools. They’re mainstream products with real marketing budgets.”
The report was released on the same day that US trade association
News/Media Alliance announced it had secured the takedown of 12ft.io
, which helped people bypass paywalls and view websites without ads, trackers or pop-ups by disguising users’ browsers as a web crawler.
The trade body called it “illegal circumvention technology”, said 12ft.io has been locked by its web host, and promised to take similar action against other paywall bypassing technologies.
Paul Bannister, chief strategy officer at ad management company Raptive, described dark traffic as “one of those industry shifts that’s been happening quietly while we’ve all been focused elsewhere.
“What’s clear is the causes behind ad blocking have become fragmented. It’s no longer purely user driven. This requires a fresh and thoughtful approach. Given the scale of what this report presents, even solving parts of this puzzle could meaningfully impact publisher economics.”
Heather Carver, chief revenue officer at programmatic adtech company Freestar, said: “As an industry, we’ve known about ad-blocking for a long time. This report changes how we should think about it.
“The growth of dark traffic undermines the ability of publishers to fund the production of quality content, or even operate as a business. We must recognise users are not the main driver causing this.”

data.title: Texas ranks as No. 1 state with the most people in financial distress
data.author: paulpauper
data.article_summary: 根据WalletHub的最新研究，德克萨斯州在2025年成为全美财务困境最严重的州，尽管其经济规模较大且GDP较高。该研究通过比较50个州的九项指标，如平均信用评分、账户困境比例和破产申请变化等，得出这一结论。德州居民的平均信用评分在全国排第九低，破产申请量增加22%，且在贷款和债务相关的搜索指数中排名靠前，表明居民借贷需求迫切。除德州外，佛罗里达、路易斯安那、内华达和南卡罗来纳也位列财务困境最严重的前五州。而夏威夷、佛蒙特和阿拉斯加则是财务困境最少的州。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[对WalletHub关于居民财务困境的州际比较研究的可信度及影响因素的讨论]

不同观点：
• [crnvbikwblcps] 认为WalletHub的研究结果不可信，特别是将加利福尼亚州排在第12位，纽约州第19位，而夏威夷州则是最后一位（第50位）。该评论者特别指出，基于搜索引擎数据（如"债务"和"贷款"的搜索兴趣指数）来判断财务困境是不合理的。

• [chris_wot] 认为德克萨斯州居民的财务困境可能与该州宽松的监管环境有很大关系，暗示监管政策可能是影响居民财务状况的重要因素，而非单纯依赖于个人金融行为或信用评分。

补充讨论：
• [crnvbikwblcps] 对搜索引擎数据的使用提出质疑，认为这种方法过于简单化，无法准确反映居民的实际财务状况。

• [chris_wot] 强调了监管环境对居民财务健康的影响，提出了一个可能的研究盲点，即不同州的法律和政策环境可能导致不同的经济结果。

争议焦点：
• 争议的核心在于WalletHub研究方法的有效性，尤其是使用搜索兴趣指数作为衡量财务困境的指标是否合理。
• 另一个争议点是影响居民财务状况的主要因素是什么，是个人行为和信用评分，还是州层面的政策和监管环境。

Texas ranks as No. 1 state with the most people in financial distress
Amber Heckler
Jul 16, 2025 | 12:22 pm
Texans are stretched thin financially.
Photo by
rc.xyz NFT gallery
on
Unsplash
Experiencing financial strife is a nightmare of many Americans, but it appears to be a looming reality  for Texans, according to a just-released WalletHub
study
ranking Texas the No. 1 most financially distressed state in America.
To determine the states with the most financially distressed residents, WalletHub compared all 50 states across nine metrics in six major categories, such as average credit scores, the share of people with "accounts in distress" (meaning an account that's in forbearance or has deferred payments), the one-year change in bankruptcy filings from March 2024, and search interest indexes for "debt" and "loans."
Joining Texas among the top five most distressed states are Florida (No. 2), Louisiana (No. 3), Nevada (No. 4), and South Carolina (No. 5).
Texas' new ranking as the most financially distressed state in 2025 may be unexpected, WalletHub says, considering the state has a "bigger GDP than most countries" and still has one of the top 10
best economies
in the nation (even though that ranking is also lower than it was in
previous years
).
Even so, Texas residents are stretching themselves very thin financially this year. Texans had the ninth lowest average credit scores nationwide during the first quarter of 2025, the study found, and Texans had the sixth-highest increase in non-business-related bankruptcy filings over the last year, toppling 22 percent.
"Texas also had the third-highest number of accounts in forbearance or with deferred payments per person, and the seventh-highest share of people with these distressed accounts, at 7.1 percent," the report said.
This is where Texas ranked across the study's six key dimensions, where No. 1 means "most distressed:"
No. 5 – "Loans" search interest index rank
No. 6 – Change in bankruptcy filings from March 2024  to March 2025 rank
No. 7 – Average number of accounts in distress rank
No. 8 – People with accounts in distress rank
No. 13 – Credit score rank and
“debt” search interest index rank
The study also clarified that the state's high search rates for "debt" and "loans" is a key indication that Texans are "desperate to borrow, despite already owing money."
Examining these financial factors on the state level is important for understanding how Americans are faring with economic issues like inflation, unemployment rates, or natural disasters, according to WalletHub analyst Chip Lupo.
"When you combine data about people delaying payments with other metrics like bankruptcy filings and credit score changes, it paints a good picture of the overall economic trends of a state," Lupo said.
At least inflation isn't impacting
Dallas
as much as other U.S. cities.
On the other side of the spectrum, states like Hawaii (No. 50), Vermont (No. 49), and Alaska (No. 48) are the least financially distressed states in America.
The top 10 states with the most people in financial distress in 2025 are:
No. 1 – Texas
No. 2 – Florida
No. 3 – Louisiana
No. 4 – Nevada
No. 5 – South Carolina
No. 6 – Oklahoma
No. 7 – North Carolina
No. 8 – Mississippi
No. 9 – Kentucky
No. 10 – Alabama

44627230.article_summary: 根据WalletHub的最新研究，德克萨斯州在2025年成为全美财务困境最严重的州，尽管其经济规模较大且GDP较高。该研究通过比较50个州的九项指标，如平均信用评分、账户困境比例和破产申请变化等，得出这一结论。德州居民的平均信用评分在全国排第九低，破产申请量增加22%，且在贷款和债务相关的搜索指数中排名靠前，表明居民借贷需求迫切。除德州外，佛罗里达、路易斯安那、内华达和南卡罗来纳也位列财务困境最严重的前五州。而夏威夷、佛蒙特和阿拉斯加则是财务困境最少的州。

不同观点：
• [crnvbikwblcps] 认为WalletHub的研究结果不可信，特别是将加利福尼亚州排在第12位，纽约州第19位，而夏威夷州则是最后一位（第50位）。该评论者特别指出，基于搜索引擎数据（如"债务"和"贷款"的搜索兴趣指数）来判断财务困境是不合理的。

• [chris_wot] 认为德克萨斯州居民的财务困境可能与该州宽松的监管环境有很大关系，暗示监管政策可能是影响居民财务状况的重要因素，而非单纯依赖于个人金融行为或信用评分。

补充讨论：
• [crnvbikwblcps] 对搜索引擎数据的使用提出质疑，认为这种方法过于简单化，无法准确反映居民的实际财务状况。

• [chris_wot] 强调了监管环境对居民财务健康的影响，提出了一个可能的研究盲点，即不同州的法律和政策环境可能导致不同的经济结果。

data.title: Why the federal government is making climate data disappear
data.author: rntn
data.article_summary: 在特朗普的第二任期内，其政府突然解散了负责国家气候评估的400名专家，并撤销了相关报告及联邦网站，导致大量气候变化信息被删除。这些报告曾是向政策制定者和公众传达气候变化影响的重要资源，如今虽被存档，但难以访问。专家认为，这种信息压制是一种新的气候否认策略，旨在削弱气候政策的科学基础。此外，政府还削减研究资金，停止气象灾害追踪等项目，进一步阻碍气候信息的获取。这种对联邦资助研究的全面压制在历史上尚无先例。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：气候数据保密与删除对气候变化应对的影响，以及其与地缘工程和政治背景的关系。

不同观点：
• [chronogamous] 认为气候数据的不透明和保密使得通过地缘工程修复生态系统的努力变得过于危险。他指出，如果未来有可能进行全球协调尝试，收集足够的数据至关重要，但如果数据丢失或被篡改，地缘工程将不再是可行选项。

• [IAmGraydon] 则将问题归结为政治动机，特别是特朗普政府删除联邦气候数据和报告，认为这是为了迎合化石燃料利益集团而采取的行动，并对此表示震惊和批评。

补充讨论：
• [chronogamous] 强调了数据完整性和透明度对于未来气候干预措施的重要性，特别是对于预测和实际结果之间的匹配。

• [IAmGraydon] 直接指责了特定政治人物和智库，认为他们的行动对气候数据的可获取性和可靠性造成了负面影响。

争议焦点：
• 数据保密和删除的动机：[chronogamous] 关注数据本身对气候干预的影响，而 [IAmGraydon] 则将其归因于政治决策和特定利益集团的影响。

• 数据丢失或篡改对气候行动的实际影响：两位评论者都认为数据问题会严重影响气候变化的应对能力，但 [chronogamous] 更关注技术层面，而 [IAmGraydon] 则侧重于政治层面。

总的来说，两位评论者都认为气候数据的缺失和不透明是一个严重问题，但对根本原因和潜在影响的看法有所不同。

For 25 years, a group of the country’s top experts has been fastidiously tracking the ways that climate change threatens every part of the United States. Their findings informed the
National Climate Assessments
, a series of congressionally mandated reports released every four years that translated the science into accessible warnings for policymakers and the public. But that work came to a halt this spring when the Trump administration abruptly
dismissed all 400 experts
working on the next edition. Then, on June 30, all of the past reports
vanished
too, along with the federal website they lived on.
A lot of information about the changing climate has disappeared under President Donald Trump’s second term, but the erasure of the National Climate Assessments is “by far the biggest loss we’ve seen,” said Gretchen Gehrke, who monitors federal websites with the Environmental Data and Governance Initiative. The National Climate Assessments were one of the most approachable resources that broke down how climate change will affect the places people care about, she said. The reports were also used by a wide swath of stakeholders — policymakers, farmers, businesses — to guide their decisions about the future.
While the reports have been
archived elsewhere
, they’re no longer as easy to access. And it’s unclear what, if anything, will happen to the report that was planned for 2027 or 2028, which already existed in
draft form
.
So why did the reports survive Trump’s first term, but not his second? You could view their disappearance in a few different ways, experts said — as a flex of executive power, an escalation in the
culture war over climate change
, or a strategic attempt to erase the scientific foundation for climate policy. “If you suppress information and data, then you don’t have the evidence you need to be able to create regulations, strengthen regulations, and even to combat the repeal of regulations,” Gehrke said.
Read Next
How your showerhead and fridge got roped into the culture wars
Kate Yoder
This isn’t climate denial in the traditional sense. The days of loudly debating the science have mostly given way to something quieter and more insidious: a campaign to withhold the raw information itself. “I don’t know if we’re living in climate denial anymore,” said Leah Aronowsky, a science historian at Columbia Climate School. “We have this new front of denial by erasure.”

Here's How
By cutting funding for research and withholding crucial data, the Trump administration is making it harder to know exactly how the planet is changing. In April, the administration pulled nearly $4 million in funding from a Princeton program to improve computer models predicting changes in the oceans and atmosphere, claiming the work
created “climate anxiety”
among young people. That same month, the Environmental Protection Agency
failed to submit its annual report
to the United Nations detailing the country’s greenhouse gas emissions. In May, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration ended its
45-year tradition of tracking billion-dollar weather disasters
. Trump also hopes to
shut down the Mauna Loa laboratory in Hawaiʻi
, which has measured the steady rise in atmospheric levels of carbon dioxide since the 1950s — the first data to definitively show humans were changing the climate.
“This kind of wholesale suppression of an entire field of federally sponsored research, to my knowledge, is historically unprecedented,” Aronowsky said.
In a response to a request for comment, a NASA spokesperson said that it has “no legal obligations to host globalchange.gov’s data,” referring to the site that hosted the National Climate Assessments, adding that the U.S. Global Change Research Program had already “met its statutory requirements by presenting its reports to Congress.” The EPA directed Grist to a webpage containing
past greenhouse gas emissions reports
, as well as a
version of what was supposed to be this year’s report
obtained by the Environmental Defense Fund. However, the agency confirmed that the latest data has not been officially released. The White House declined to comment, and the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration did not respond.
Last year,
a leaked training video from Project 2025
— the policy roadmap organized by The Heritage Foundation, a conservative think tank — showed a former Trump official declaring that political appointees would have to “eradicate climate change references from absolutely everywhere.” The strategy appears to be designed to boost the fossil fuel industry at a time when clean energy has become competitive and the reality

data.article_summary: 文章提到，某些与隐私相关的浏览器扩展程序可能会导致在x.com（即推特的域名）上出现问题。建议用户禁用这些扩展程序，然后重试访问网站。这是为了确保用户能够顺利使用该平台，而不受扩展程序的干扰。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：LLM（大型语言模型）在生产环境数据库操作中的风险和责任归属，以及AI工具的当前能力和使用限制。

不同观点：
• codechicago277：认为问题完全在于人类操作员，因为他们没有理解将模型直接连接到生产数据库的风险，且在没有备份的情况下更是不可原谅。此外，试图将责任推给LLM是不合理的，因为LLM被训练成迎合用户。
• Ecstatify：不同意将AI错误与人类错误等同视之。AI是工具，其行为受编程限制，不是自主选择的结果，因此不应像对待人类一样对待AI。
• clickety_clack：批评了对LLM工作原理的误解，指出LLM是生成代码的工具，没有内部思考能力，直接执行代码而没有事先策略。
• maxbond：强调不应在生产环境中给予LLM写入权限，这是不专业的做法。在足够长的时间内，LLM破坏生产环境的可能性接近100%。
• Grimblewald：认为LLM目前仅适用于样板代码生成，且需要严密监控。它们尚不足以处理更复杂的任务。
• consumer451：分享了自己使用LLM开发工具的经验，指出这些工具目前还不够可靠，无法用于生产环境数据库操作。并质疑这些工具是否缺乏必要的防护措施。

补充讨论：
• Proofread0592：分享了一个相关Twitter线程链接。
• cozzyd、Arn_Thor：以幽默方式评论AI相关事件。
• blotfaba、cap11235：质疑事件的真实性，认为可能是恶作剧或玩笑。
• layer8、mnafees：提到AI工具在删除操作中的风险，并分享相关笑话或实例。
• add-sub-mul-div：讨论了当前计算机编程的确定性问题，认为未来可能会实现更确定的编程方式。
• nextaccountic：强调备份的重要性，指出无论是否使用AI，数据丢失的风险始终存在。

争议焦点：
• 责任归属：是人类操作员的责任，还是LLM工具本身的问题。
• LLM的当前能力与使用限制：LLM是否足够可靠以用于生产环境，以及使用者对其风险的理解和防护措施。

data.title: Can Software Be Durable?
data.author: maraoz
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：软件的长久可持续性和如何实现软件的长期维护

不同观点：
• JonChesterfield: 认为五十年前的模拟软件今天仍然可以使用，强调无依赖性和跨平台可移植性是长久运行的关键。同时指出依赖互联网获取资源的软件寿命较短，并质疑现代编程语言的持久性。
• al_borland: 批评过度追求趋势和技术更新，认为不断重构和更新带来了更多的漏洞和问题，主张追求稳定而非频繁变化。
• robin_reala: 通过Space Invaders游戏的例子说明自包含、可重现和可移植性是软件长久运行的关键因素，且需要持续的需求来驱动其存在。
• bullen: 认为C语言和Java具有较强的持久性，C因其与操作系统兼容性好，Java因其虚拟机技术可以跨平台使用，但指出Java的未来依赖于JVM的维护。
• jfk13: 以TeX软件为例，说明经过少量维护和功能添加，软件可以长久使用并保持稳定性。
• aristofun: 认为软件更像管道系统，需要定期维护和人员管理，而不是像锤子或推土机那样的静态工具。
• ARothfusz: 通过Voyager探测器的例子说明假设软件必须工作、内置故障保护和冗余设计的重要性，并强调可重复构建和日志理解能力。
• poisonborz: 主张使用最少依赖和成熟稳定的API，以确保环境可被轻松模拟，从而延长软件寿命。
• mamcx: 提出需要从硬件、网络、存储和电力等多方面考虑软件的长期可持续性，并建议使用Rust或C语言及SQLite等稳定工具。
• codingdave: 强调技术演进和人才断层的问题，认为软件需要模块化和可重构，以适应人才变化和需求演变。
• comrade1234: 认为软件不应是静态的，可以通过增加新功能和修复漏洞来延长生命周期，但大多数项目可能无法长久存在，因此不必过度追求完美。
• ciconia: 主张尽量简化和减少代码及依赖，以降低维护成本和复杂性。
• rcxdude: 指出软件需要对运行环境有足够的吸引力或实用性，以便人们愿意维护其运行，开源和高效性有助于其持久性。
• rickcarlino: 强调选择广泛部署的硬件和编写无时间限制的文档，以及最小化依赖性是软件长久运行的关键。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于软件是否应该追求稳定性和少变化（如al_borland和ciconia的观点），还是应该通过不断更新和重构来适应变化（如comrade1234的观点）。
• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是关于依赖性和可移植性的讨论（JonChesterfield、poisonborz和rcxdude的观点），强调无依赖性和自包含性是软件长久运行的关键因素。
• 还有对编程语言和工具的选择的讨论（bullen和mamcx的观点），认为选择成熟稳定的编程语言和工具可以提高软件的持久性。
• 最后，通过具体案例（如TeX和Voyager探测器）的分析，提供了实现软件长久运行的具体实践和设计原则（jfk13和ARothfusz的观点）。

• robin_reala: 通过Space Invaders游戏的例子说明自包含、可重现和可移植性是软件长久运行的关键因素，且需要持续的需求来驱动其存在。
• bullen: 认为C语言和Java具有较强的持久性，C因其与操作系统兼容性好，Java因其虚拟机技术可以跨平台使用，但指出Java的未来依赖于JVM的维护。
• jfk13: 以TeX软件为例，说明经过少量维护和功能添加，软件可以长久使用并保持稳定性。
• aristofun: 认为软件更像管道系统，需要定期维护和人员管理，而不是像锤子或推土机那样的静态工具。
• ARothfusz: 通过Voyager探测器的例子说明假设软件必须工作、内置故障保护和冗余设计的重要性，并强调可重复构建和日志理解能力。
• poisonborz: 主张使用最少依赖和成熟稳定的API，以确保环境可被轻松模拟，从而延长软件寿命。
• mamcx: 提出需要从硬件、网络、存储和电力等多方面考虑软件的长期可持续性，并建议使用Rust或C语言及SQLite等稳定工具。
• codingdave: 强调技术演进和人才断层的问题，认为软件需要模块化和可重构，以适应人才变化和需求演变。
• comrade1234: 认为软件不应是静态的，可以通过增加新功能和修复漏洞来延长生命周期，但大多数项目可能无法长久存在，因此不必过度追求完美。
• ciconia: 主张尽量简化和减少代码及依赖，以降低维护成本和复杂性。
• rcxdude: 指出软件需要对运行环境有足够的吸引力或实用性，以便人们愿意维护其运行，开源和高效性有助于其持久性。
• rickcarlino: 强调选择广泛部署的硬件和编写无时间限制的文档，以及最小化依赖性是软件长久运行的关键。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于软件是否应该追求稳定性和少变化（如al_borland和ciconia的观点），还是应该通过不断更新和重构来适应变化（如comrade1234的观点）。
• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是关于依赖性和可移植性的讨论（JonChesterfield、poisonborz和rcxdude的观点），强调无依赖性和自包含性是软件长久运行的关键因素。
• 还有对编程语言和工具的选择的讨论（bullen和mamcx的观点），认为选择成熟稳定的编程语言和工具可以提高软件的持久性。
• 最后，通过具体案例（如TeX和Voyager探测器）的分析，提供了实现软件长久运行的具体实践和设计原则（jfk13和ARothfusz的观点）。

data.title: Java Processor
data.author: danielschreber
data.article_summary: Java处理器是将Java虚拟机（JVM）以硬件方式实现的处理器，其指令集基于Java字节码。这类处理器曾广泛用于嵌入式和实时系统，但到2017年，嵌入式Java已不再常见，且无实时Java芯片供应商。多个研究项目在FPGA上测试了Java处理器，包括Sun Microsystems的picoJava及其升级版picoJava-II。其他实现包括jHISC、Java Optimized Processor（JOP）以及aJile处理器。ARM926EJ-S处理器通过Jazelle技术支持运行Java字节码。

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
Processor using Java bytecode as its instruction set
A
Java processor
is the implementation of the
Java virtual machine
(JVM) in hardware. In other words, the
Java bytecode
that makes up the instruction set of the abstract machine becomes the instruction set of a concrete machine. These were the most popular form of a
high-level language computer architecture
, and were "an attractive choice for building embedded and real-time systems that are programmed in Java".

data.author: RF_Enthusiast
data.article_summary: 国会决定收回11亿美元的公共媒体联邦资金，受影响最严重的是为农村地区提供本地新闻和信息的社区电台，如西弗吉尼亚州和弗吉尼亚州交界处的阿勒格尼山地广播（Allegheny Mountain Radio）。该电台依赖公共广播公司（CPB）资助，占其年度预算的65%。电台经理斯科特·史密斯担心预算缺口可能导致裁员或关闭电台，因为这些地区手机和互联网信号不稳定，电台是居民获取本地新闻和信息的重要来源。市长和居民都表示，若失去电台，社区将失去关键的日常信息渠道。

Public media cuts hit some rural areas that voted for Trump
Congress voted to claw back federal funding to public media. Some of those hit hardest include community radio stations in areas that voted for the president.
Politics
Community radio stations are collateral damage as Congress cuts NPR funding
July 20, 2025
12:01 AM ET
Frank Langfitt
Abby DuFour, WCHG news reporter and afternoon host of the show
DuFour Du Jour
, cues up the next song in her broadcast at the station in Hot Springs, Va.
Kristian Thacker for NPR
hide caption
toggle caption
Kristian Thacker for NPR
DUNMORE, West Virginia — When President Trump pushed to slash federal funding for public media, he said a key reason was because he thinks
PBS and NPR are politically biased
. But some of those hardest hit by Congress' decision last week
to clawback $1.1 billion
in federal funds are small radio operations that provide local news and information to rural communities.
One is
Allegheny Mountain Radio
, a cooperative of three stations which cover Pocahontas County, West Virginia as well as Bath and Highland counties in Virginia. Allegheny Mountain is not an NPR member station, but it does run NPR's daily newscast, a quick run down of top stories.
Sponsor Message
Allegheny Mountain's mix of programming includes local news and information as well as gospel, country and blues shows. A recent episode of the
Noon Hour Magazine
reported on a $5,000 signing bonus to attract new teachers and how the energy demands from data centers could eventually affect this remote region where people sometimes have to drive 60 miles to reach the nearest shopping center.
Allegheny Mountain Radio's WVLS, which sits in the picturesque mountain town of Monterey, Va., provides local government news, funeral notices and information on missing pets to listeners in areas where it can be hard to access cell phone signals and the internet.
Kristian Thacker for NPR
hide caption
toggle caption
Kristian Thacker for NPR
The show also featured a regular segment on missing pets, in this case a dilute calico with a stripe down its nose.
"I have read a lost and found pet report for an emu that was wandering around the county,
"
recalls
Scott Smith, Allegheny Mountain's general manager.
Allegheny Mountain relies on funding from the Corporation for Public Broadcasting (CPB) for up to 65 percent of its annual budget of about half a million dollars. Smith says his stations do have financial reserves, but the hole in their budget could become existential.
"There is only so long that you can continue to exist when you are operating in the red," says Smith, who has a long gray beard that stretches nearly to his belt buckle. "At some point that well runs dry."
Scott Smith, Allegheny Mountain Radio's general manager, sits in the main broadcasting studio at station WVLS in Monterey, Va. Smith says Congress' decision last week to slash public media funding could wipe out up to 65 percent of his budget.
Kristian Thacker for NPR
hide caption
toggle caption
Kristian Thacker for NPR
Smith hopes to raise more money to try to fill some of the gap, but he worries that eventually he may have to cut staff or even shut a station. Allegheny Mountain is among nearly 70 small radio stations in states such as Alaska, Kentucky, Texas and Mississippi that have relied on the CPB for at least 30 percent of their annual budgets.
Sponsor Message
Smith says the radio cooperative helps knit together a region where it isn't easy to connect because of the mountains and the spotty access to phone and internet. Much of its coverage area lies inside the Monongahela and George Washington and Jefferson National forests. During a nearly 75-mile drive from an interstate to WVMR, which sits in Dunmore, W. Va., an NPR reporter had no internet connection.
Some people here say they really value the news and community information Allegheny Mountain provides. Jay Garber, mayor of the
town of Monterey, Va
., says the radio remains the fastest way to let citizens know about everything from water main breaks to road closures.
Jay Garber, mayor of Monterey, says the community relies on the radio for daily, local news and information. "Without the radio station, we're kind of in the blind here, locally," he says.
Kristian Thacker for NPR
hide caption
toggle caption
Kristian Thacker for NPR
"It's our only source of local, daily information," says Garber, sitting in his office along Main Street. "We have a newspaper that's printed once a week, so without the radio station, we're kind of in the blind here, locally."
Just down the block from the mayor's office, Jean Hiner is finishing up her french fries at Highs Restaurant, where customers are encouraged to ring a bell on the way out if they like the food. Hiner, 79, who used to raise sheep, says Allegheny Mountain also provides essential information about the people here.

data.title: The landlord gutting America’s hospitals
data.author: hhs
data.article_summary: 2024年4月，路易斯安那州格伦伍德地区医疗中心的医务人员在州众议院健康与福利委员会作证，揭露医院因管理不善面临严重问题。医院拖欠氧气供应、血库费用及电梯维修费，前护士Debra Russell提到，医院缺乏必要设备和人员，影响病人护理。该医院由Steward Health Care运营，但建筑归Medical Properties Trust（MPT）所有，MPT收取高额租金。类似情况导致多家租赁医院破产，而MPT高层却获利数百万。Mother Jones的报道深入分析了MPT的商业模式及其对医院财务的负面影响。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对资产剥离、美国医疗系统问题以及资本主义与命令经济的对比讨论

不同观点：
• [RainyDayTmrw] 认为资产剥离是一种利用系统漏洞获取个人利益的行为，对社会有害，主张应加强监管。然而，具体哪些行为应被禁止并不明确，尤其是当每个单独行为都在规则允许范围内时。

• [toomuchtodo] 提到了Medical Properties Trust，但未深入阐述，可能暗示对特定机构或行为的关注。

• [ck2] 强调美国医疗系统面临的重大问题，包括即将失去保险的1300万人和翻倍的ACA保费，预测这种破碎的系统将导致医院关闭和更多人依赖急诊室作为初级医疗。还提到基础设施维修不及时的问题。

• [jmyeet] 对比了美国和中国的经济体系，指出美国在医疗等领域的过高成本和较差效果，批评资本主义下的创新多为租金寻求和财富转移。赞扬中国在基础设施建设上的成就，并预测美国当前系统将在未来崩溃。

补充讨论：
• [RainyDayTmrw] 对资产剥离的道德批判以及对具体监管措施的困惑。
• [ck2] 对美国医疗系统即将面临的危机进行了具体描述，特别是对经济困难群体影响的关注。
• [jmyeet] 提供了数据链接支持其关于美国医疗系统高成本低效率的观点，并通过对比中国的高速铁路建设成就，批评美国政府在财富分配上的失衡。

争议焦点：
• 资产剥离是否应被严格监管以及如何在规则允许范围内识别不当行为。
• 美国医疗系统的效率和公平性问题，特别是与其它经济体系如中国的对比。
• 资本主义与命令经济在创新和社会福利方面的优劣对比。

In April 2024,
medical staff testified before Louisiana’s House Health and Welfare Committee about just how bad things had gotten at the Glenwood Regional Medical Center.
The West Monroe hospital had been under fire from the state Health Department over lapses in patient care that seemed to be escalating. The hospital had stopped paying bills for oxygen supplies, the blood bank, and repairs to the elevators that take patients up to surgery.
Former Glenwood nurse Debra Russell testified that there wasn’t a cardiologist available when a man suffered a heart attack or a $5 piece of equipment she needed for a routine procedure.
“You would send a nurse to go get it,” Russell said. “And she would come back and say, ‘Oh, Miss Debra, I don’t have any.’ I said, ‘Go to another unit.’…‘We don’t have one.’”
Glenwood was run by
Steward Health Care
, at the time one of the country’s largest for-profit health care operators. But its building was owned by Medical Properties Trust—a real estate company based in Birmingham, Alabama, that charged Glenwood monthly rent.
Related
Wall Street Gutted Steward Health Care. Patients Paid the Price.
State Rep. Michael Echols, a Republican whose district includes Glenwood, had been flooded with concerns from community members. Echols had begun to wonder whether the high rent to MPT was fueling Glenwood’s financial crisis. He struggled to get real answers.
Glenwood is just one of nearly 400 health care facilities owned by MPT and rented out to hospital chains. Nine companies that leased hospitals from MPT have gone bankrupt—including Steward, Glenwood’s former operator. And while dozens of hospitals have been sold, entangled in bankruptcy proceedings, or become depleted shells, MPT’s top brass has earned millions.

Reveal
,
Mother Jones
reporter Hannah Levintova and
Reveal
producer Ashley Cleek dig into MPT—its history, its business model, and how treating hospitals like financial assets leaves them gutted. And don’t miss Levintova’s
yearlong reporting project on Steward’s demise
, including our collaboration with Al Jazeera’s
Fault Lines

44627239.article_content:
Employees could face higher deductibles and out-of-pocket costs next year.
LaylaBird/E+/Getty Images
CNN
—
Battered by multiple years of high health care costs, employers are planning to shift more of the expense to workers in 2026, a new survey released Wednesday found.
Just over half of employers are planning to adjust their health insurance offerings to increase staffers’ share of the cost, such as instituting higher deductibles or annual out-of-pocket maximums, according to Mercer’s Survey on Health and Benefit Strategies for 2026.
The tight labor market and rising cost of living in recent years had made companies more reluctant to add to workers’ financial burden, Mercer said. Some 45% of employers reported in 2025 that they would shift more costs to staffers.
“Employers are thinking, we’re at a point where we can’t do another year of not passing along some of the cost increases,” said Beth Umland, director of research at Mercer’s Health and Benefits business.
Companies expected their health benefits expenses to jump by nearly 6% this year, after experiencing a 4.5% increase in 2024.
Costs will likely rise at an even higher rate next year, driven in part by patients’ increased usage and doctors using artificial intelligence to more accurately bill insurers, said Sunit Patel, US chief health actuary at Mercer.
Another area of cost concern is coverage of anti-obesity GLP-1 medications, which are very popular but very expensive. Nearly two-thirds of companies with 20,000 or more workers provided such coverage in 2024, while 44% of employers with 500 or more workers did.
The pace of employers adding such coverage is likely to slow in 2026, Umland said.
Companies may be reluctant to stop providing the benefit but may narrow eligibility or require more documentation — making it more difficult for workers to access it, Patel said.
Meanwhile, employers remain committed to providing mental health services for staffers, the survey found. More are offering onsite Employee Assistance Program counseling services — some 35% will do so next year, up from 29% this year. They are also providing more sessions, moving to six to eight sessions, rather than the traditional three to five.
Also, as employers increasingly require staffers to return to the office, companies are more interested in providing child care or elder care benefits, Mercer found. Some 54% of large employers provide — or will offer next year — at least one child care resource, including a platform to search for child care, access to backup child care services or tuition discounts.
Likewise, 58% of large employers offer or plan to provide at least one type of elder care benefit, including grief counseling, a platform to search for elder care or access to backup elder care services.
Some 59% of employers will offer at least one resource to support women’s reproductive health, including lactation support, high-risk pregnancy and pre-conception family planning.
Employees will find out more details about their health care benefits for the coming year during the annual open enrollment period, which typically occurs in the fall.

data.article_summary: 文章主要讨论了电动汽车（EV）可能导致乘客晕车的问题。尽管电动汽车因其平稳和安静的特性被认为更舒适，但研究表明，缺乏内燃机车的音频和振动信号让乘客更难预测车辆运动，从而加剧晕车感。再生制动和单踏板驾驶模式也被认为是导致晕车的因素，因为这些特性改变了传统的驾驶和乘坐体验。文章提到，随着人们对电动汽车的适应增加，未来晕车问题可能减少，但仍需时间验证。此外，文章还探讨了电动汽车技术的发展和其他相关趋势。

One of the first things that hits you about the EV experience is its relative smoothness, compared to internal-combustion cars, with their vibrations and noise. You might assume that these attributes would make EVs more comfortable for those who tend to get
carsick
, but research has found that the opposite is in fact true. Electric vehicles can exacerbate sensations of motion sickness in passengers, and science tells us why.
It’s more or less the same reason why you never hear about drivers getting carsick. If you’re driving a car, you know how the vehicle is about to react as you manipulate the gas, brakes, and steering. Your passengers don’t, though—they can only guess. And that mismatch in expectation versus physical reality gets to the root of what causes motion sickness.
Now consider an electric vehicle. All of those audio and kinetic cues that have defined cars for more than a century are now gone. There’s no rumbling engine to signal movement, and, in most models, the driver doesn’t even need to press the brake pedal to quickly slow down; the car does it automatically and steadily off acceleration. Passengers have even fewer signs to instinctively pick up on, and this can lead to problems, as William Emond, a PhD student at France’s Université de Technologie de Belfort-Montbéliard, told
The Guardian
.
“If we are accustomed to traveling in non-EVs, we are used to understanding the car’s motion based on signals such as engine revs, engine vibrations, torque, etc. Yet, traveling in an EV for the first time is a new motion environment for the brain, which needs adaptation,” Emond explains.
Emond sums it up as the brain lacking “accuracy in estimating the motion forces” of EVs, compared to our ability to estimate how gas cars behave. Two studies cited by
The Guardian
back this up: One from 2020 linked the silence of EVs to increased carsickness, while another from 2024 related seat vibrations to the phenomenon.
Regenerative braking is part of the problem, too, as “low-frequency deceleration,” rather than quick stabs of the brake pedal, has also been correlated with increased motion sickness. This one is admittedly a little surprising because you’d assume a slower, more gradual movement would result in less fatigue for passengers. I’m no expert, but if I had to guess, the progression from sharp acceleration to relatively sharp deceleration
without
a coasting phase—as most EVs default to
one-pedal driving
—plays a part. That sequence goes against what we’ve all been primed to expect, riding in gas cars all our lives.
As EVs grow within the market, it will be interesting to explore whether motion sickness will become less common, because we’ll all have built more experience with them. Consider young kids in the coming decades, who might have limited or no experience with combustion-powered cars; maybe they’ll fare better than us today. Even so, perhaps a larger subset of people in the future will still be prone to carsickness in an all-EV world, compared to the all-ICE one we grew up in. So many questions, and the only thing that will answer them is time.

data.title: When root meets immutable: OpenBSD chflags vs. log tampering
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: 本文主要讨论了ISO 27001标准对不可变日志的需求，尽管其并未明确说明。ISO 27001要求保护日志不被篡改和未经授权的访问，但未提供具体实现方法。在安全事件调查中，日志的可靠性取决于其防篡改能力，特别是在攻击者获得根权限时。文章介绍了一种通过使用OpenBSD的SF_IMMUTABLE标志来实现不可变日志的方法，确保日志在创建后无法被修改或删除。OpenBSD的默认日志配置通过newsyslog定期轮换日志，防止磁盘空间耗尽，但这也为攻击者提供了篡改机会。因此，采用不可变日志是保证日志完整性和满足ISO 27001合规要求的关键措施。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：如何有效保护日志不被恶意篡改，特别是通过不可变标志和外部日志服务器的方式。

不同观点：
• dspillett认为，即使使用不可变标志，拥有root权限的攻击者仍可能在达到目的后破坏系统以掩盖痕迹。他主张将日志流式传输到另一台机器上存储，以满足不可变要求，同时指出这增加了基础设施的复杂性。
• louwrentius强调，外部日志服务器是实现不可变日志的正确方法，并提到通过防火墙和权限管理（如四眼原则）来保护日志服务器，认为其他方式像是安全表演。
• johnisgood分享了使用"chattr +i"命令在Linux上使文件不可变的实际经验，如保护/etc/resolv.conf文件，表明这种方法在某些情况下是有效的。
• h43z提出了关于日志轮换是否需要重启的疑问，这涉及到不可变标志在实际操作中的适用性。
• comex质疑通过修改配置文件和重启系统来绕过安全级别的可能性，指出这种方式的潜在漏洞。
• bananapub认为不可变标志是一种有用的建议性功能，但防止日志篡改的真正解决方案是将日志转移到无法访问的安全域中，如日志服务器。
• eternauta3k询问是否阻止root直接写入底层设备块，这涉及到更深层次的技术实现。
• mrtesthah补充了macOS系统上chflags属性的历史，指出甚至在System Integrity Protection之前，这些标志就需要单用户模式才能更改。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中多次提到外部日志服务器的重要性，以及通过权限管理和基础设施保护来增强安全性。
• 争议的焦点在于不可变标志的有效性以及其在面对拥有root权限的攻击者时的局限性，外部日志服务器被广泛认为是更可靠的解决方案。
• 不同技术背景下的具体实现方式（如Linux和macOS）也被讨论，提供了多种技术细节和实例。

Why ISO 27001 Demands Immutable Logs (Without Actually Saying So)
#
ISO 27001 is like that careful lawyer who never says exactly what they mean â
it tells you what needs to be achieved, not how to do it. When it comes to
logging, this is particularly telling: Control A.12.4.2 simply states that
“logging information and logging facilities shall be protected against
tampering and unauthorized access.” Period. How? That’s your problem to solve.
But anyone who’s ever had to investigate a security incident knows the harsh
reality: logs are only as trustworthy as their protection against post-incident
tampering. An attacker who gains root access isn’t going to politely leave
their tracks in the log files â unless they physically can’t alter them
anymore.
Anyone who follows this blog knows I’ve been diving into VFS/FFS code lately,
and during that exploration, I stumbled across SF_APPEND and SF_IMMUTABLE flags
in the kernel source. “IMMUTABLE?” I thought. “What the hack, OpenBSD can do that? Must
be dead code ;)”. Turns out these flags are very much alive and can be
beautifully set using
chflags
. I started playing around with them in /tmp,
and for days afterward, I’d get a bunch of error messages on every boot
because OpenBSD, as you know, cleans /tmp on startup. I left it like that for a
while â just another quirky reminder of my filesystem experiments.
Then a client I administrate several OpenBSD servers for asked me about ISO
27001 compliance. Suddenly, those “dead” immutable flags didn’t seem so useless
anymore. In fact, they turned out to be exactly what the standard was asking
for, even if it doesn’t explicitly say so.
This is where immutability becomes not just a nice-to-have, but a forensic
necessity. While ISO 27001 never mentions the word “immutable”, it’s
essentially describing exactly that: logs that cannot be modified after they’re
written. This isn’t security theater â it’s about maintaining the integrity of
your audit trail when it matters most.
But there’s a deeper motivation here beyond just checking the compliance box.
If an attacker gains root privileges on your system without you knowing, you
have a massive problem. Your logs might be the only evidence of what happened,
when it happened, and how extensive the breach was. If those logs can be
silently modified or deleted, you’re essentially flying blind during the most
critical moment of your security response.
The following blog post shows one approach to having
secure
,
root-tamper-proof logs
and archiving them
IMMUTABLE
without any
external system.
OpenBSD’s Default Logging: Simple but Effective
#
OpenBSD ships with a straightforward logging configuration that handles most
system events out of the box. The default
/etc/syslog.conf
follows a clean
separation of concerns:
*.notice;auth,authpriv,cron,ftp,kern,lpr,mail,user.none	/var/log/messages
kern.debug;syslog,user.info				/var/log/messages
auth.info						/var/log/authlog
authpriv.debug						/var/log/secure
cron.info						/var/cron/log
daemon.info						/var/log/daemon
ftp.info						/var/log/xferlog
lpr.debug						/var/log/lpd-errs
mail.info						/var/log/maillog
# ....
#!doas
#*.*							/var/log/doas
This configuration creates a logical hierarchy: general system messages land in
/var/log/messages
, while specific services get their own dedicated log files.
Authentication attempts go to
/var/log/authlog
, privileged operations to
/var/log/secure
, and so on.
The beauty of this setup is its predictability. When you need to investigate a
login issue, you know exactly where to look. Mail problems? Check
/var/log/maillog
. System crashes?
/var/log/messages
has your answers.
But here’s where it gets interesting from a security perspective: newsyslog
runs as a root cron job every hour, rotating these logs automatically. A quick
look at
/etc/newsyslog.conf
shows the rotation schedule:
/var/cron/log		root:wheel	600  3     10   *     Z
/var/log/authlog	root:wheel	640  7     *    168   Z
/var/log/daemon				640  5     300  *     Z
/var/log/lpd-errs			640  7     10   *     Z
/var/log/maillog			640  7     *    24    Z
/var/log/messages			644  5     300  *     Z
/var/log/secure				600  7     *    168   Z
/var/log/wtmp				644  7     *    $M1D4 B ""
/var/log/xferlog			640  7     250  *     Z
/var/log/pflog				600  3     250  *     ZB "pkill -HUP -u root -U root -t - -x pflogd"
/var/www/logs/access.log		644  4     *    $W0   Z "pkill -USR1 -u root -U root -x httpd"
/var/www/logs/error.log			644  7     250  *     Z "pkill -USR1 -u root -U root -x httpd"
While this prevents logs from consuming all available disk space, it also means
that log files are regularly recreated, moved, and compressed. From an
attacker’s perspective, this creates windows of opportunity â not just to
modify logs, but to potentially interfere with the rotation process itself.
Even more concerning: any attacker with root access can simply open the log
files directly and delete specific lines,
44602532.article_summary: 本文主要讨论了ISO 27001标准对不可变日志的需求，尽管其并未明确说明。ISO 27001要求保护日志不被篡改和未经授权的访问，但未提供具体实现方法。在安全事件调查中，日志的可靠性取决于其防篡改能力，特别是在攻击者获得根权限时。文章介绍了一种通过使用OpenBSD的SF_IMMUTABLE标志来实现不可变日志的方法，确保日志在创建后无法被修改或删除。OpenBSD的默认日志配置通过newsyslog定期轮换日志，防止磁盘空间耗尽，但这也为攻击者提供了篡改机会。因此，采用不可变日志是保证日志完整性和满足ISO 27001合规要求的关键措施。

data.title: Jove (Jonathan's Own Version of Emacs)
data.author: nanna
data.article_summary: JOVE（Jonathan's Own Version of Emacs）是一款开源的、类似于Emacs的文本编辑器，主要用于Unix-like操作系统，也支持MS-DOS和Microsoft Windows。它由Jonathan Payne于1983年创建，灵感来自Gosling Emacs，但更小巧简单，不支持Mocklisp。JOVE曾随多个BSD Unix版本发布，最新稳定版为4.16，开发版为4.17.4.4。与GNU Emacs不同，JOVE不支持UTF-8编码。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：JOVE文本编辑器的使用体验及其与其它编辑器（如Emacs、Vi、JED）的比较

不同观点：
• **nanna**：认为JOVE是一个有帮助的轻量级终端编辑器，适合快速编辑任务，相较于`nano`或`emacs -nw`更实用。
• **purkka**：指出JOVE不支持UTF-8编码，并对此表示惊讶，因为这一问题在2023年仍然存在。
• **jbellis**：回忆过去在DOS系统上使用JED编辑器的经历，并提到JED至今仍在GitHub上维护，甚至最近还有针对VMS系统的更新。
• **jerrysievert**：分享自己从Emacs转向JOVE，再回到Emacs，最终转向Vi/Vim的经历。JOVE在资源有限的系统上表现良好，但最终被现代IDE取代。
• **sombragris**：提到JOVE是Slackware系统的默认安装编辑器之一，尽管Emacs也是选项之一，但个人更偏好JED，认为其界面更友好。
• **ridruejo**：JOVE和JED曾是Emacs过于笨重时的选择，某些情况下依然会使用。
• **ww520**：JOVE是其Unix系统上的第一个编辑器，因Emacs资源占用过大而选择JOVE。
• **zzzeek**：在1989年使用过Emacs，但Vi一直是其主要选择。

补充讨论：
• **fmajid**：提醒大家不要将JOVE与JOVIAL（一种曾用于美国空中交通控制系统的编程语言）混淆。
• **DonHopkins**：通过与JOVE开发者Jonathan Payne的个人经历，带入了与技术无关的争议性话题，提到Payne的极端言论及其引发的个人和社区冲突，但此内容与JOVE编辑器本身的技术讨论无直接关系。

争议焦点：
• JOVE不支持UTF-8编码的问题被purkka指出并引起关注，这被认为是其在现代使用中的一个显著缺陷。
• DonHopkins分享的内容引发了对JOVE开发者个人行为的争议，但并未直接涉及JOVE编辑器的技术讨论。

data.title: Simulating Hand-Drawn Motion with SVG Filters
data.author: camillovisini
data.article_summary:
本文介绍了一种使用SVG滤镜和JavaScript实现手绘抖动动画效果的实用指南，称为“boiling line”效果。这种效果常用于卡通动画，通过轻微变形和循环播放，使静态图像看起来像在微微移动。文章分解了实现该效果的两个主要步骤：

1. **边缘扭曲**：使用SVG滤镜`feTurbulence`和`feDisplacementMap`来生成噪声纹理并扭曲形状边缘，使其看起来不那么规则。
2. **动画效果**：通过JavaScript定期更新这些滤镜参数，实现动态变化，使静态图像更具动感。

文章还提供了一个代码示例，展示了如何设置SVG滤镜效果以实现这种扭曲动画。这种方法可以在网页上模拟手绘动画的抖动效果，增加视觉吸引力。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：SVG效果的使用及其技术实现和性能问题

不同观点：
• [memalign] 认为该技术与PICO-8的Wobblepaint类似，强调其有趣的摆动效果。
• [jchw] 分享了使用SVG效果的经验，指出尽管SVG滤镜功能强大，但在实际应用中，即使Firefox提供了一定程度的GPU加速，很多简单的图形仍会回退到CPU处理，导致性能问题，特别是feTurbulence滤镜对CPU的负担较大。
• [hamish-b] 描述了自己在kurnell.ai上手工完成类似效果的经历，并使用了rive.app来编码帧和创建状态机，表示有可能进一步简化。
• [gabriben] 认为该技术很酷，并提到一个两周前的帖子，建议将两种方法结合使用。
• [nine_k] 认为该技术的效果类似于热空气扭曲，但缺乏闪烁感，更像是一种光栅效果，可能是通过GPU着色器实现的。他还提出了通过振荡节点和添加随机抖动来模拟不稳定人手效果的方法。
• [mirkodrummer] 感叹SVG有很多未被充分探索的能力，仅仅用于网页图标是一种浪费。
• [tubs] 表示该网站在手机上浏览时导致设备过热，暗示性能优化不足。
• [teeray] 提供了Squigglevision的维基百科链接作为参考。

补充讨论：
• 评论中提到了多种工具和技术的使用，如rive.app和PICO-8的Wobblepaint，显示出社区对多种工具组合应用的兴趣。
• 性能问题是讨论的一个焦点，特别是CPU和GPU的负载平衡以及在不同设备上的表现。
• 对SVG效果的实现方式和技术细节有不同的看法，如光栅效果与振荡节点的对比。
• 评论中还包含了一些幽默和轻松的元素，如"手机变成了熔岩"的夸张表达。

44591305.article_content:
Simulating Hand-Drawn Motion with SVG Filters
A practical guide to implementing the boiling line animation effect using SVG filter primitives and JavaScript
Published on
July 09, 2025
Ever wondered how cartoons create that hand-drawn “jitter” effect? I recently watched an
ARTE documentary
about Neapolitan pizza and was fascinated by the animated illustrations (drawn in simple shapes and plain colors) that accompanied the
segment
where the recipe and its ingredients were presented. The illustrations were static, but they had a subtle animation effect that made them look like they were moving slightly.
See for example in this short clip, where you can see the ingredients being presented (pay attention to the edges of the shapes):
Animated illustration of ingredients for Pizza Napoli - Source: ARTE
I was curious to find out how this effect might have been achieved. First, I had to find out what it was called – turns out that this specific effect is actually quite common in cartoon-style animations and illustrations.
After some research, I found out that this effect is called
“boiling”
or
line boil
and was traditionally achieved by drawing the same frame multiple times in a row, with slight variations in position and rotation. This creates the illusion of movement in an otherwise static scene. The technique is often used in animation to create a more dynamic and engaging visual experience (instead of just a static image or scene, for example when a character is standing still).
Let’s take a look at a simple example of this effect in the demo below. I have traced the same object multiple times. Naturally, as these drawings are tracings by hand and not perfect copies, there are subtle differences between them. But, this becomes only apparent when the drawings are overlaid and animated!
When looking closely at the initial short clip, you will notice that the effect is more of a trick. There seems to be a layer of a rough paper-like texture with some kind of overlay effect that is applied to the whole scene, giving it a dynamic quality. That’s not the part we will focus on, though.
More interestingly, the edges of the shapes seem to wobble slightly and appear gritty or sketch-like, as if they were drawn by hand. But are they drawn by hand, as in my demo above? I don’t think that’s the case, because the contours are wobbling “in a loop”. Or in other words: The boiling effect is somehow achieved artificially: Rather than by drawing the same frame multiple times with slight variations, it seems to be a post-processing effect applied to the static illustrations, which were likely drawn as “perfect” shapes.
This blog post describes my attempt to recreate this effect in a simple way and bring it to the web. Let’s dive in.
Decomposing the effect
To recreate the boiling effect, we can break it down into two main components:
Distorting the edges
: The edges of the shapes should not be perfectly straight, but rather have a slight wobble that gives them a more organic and hand-drawn look. This could be achieved by applying a distortion effect to the edges of the shapes – which could be controlled by a set of parameters.
Animating the effect
: Then, these
distortion parameters
are animated over time (for example, updated with new values every 200 milliseconds), creating a subtle movement that makes an otherwise static scene feel more engaging.
Probably, the second part is intuitive to understand, but the first part is a bit more complex. Because we are trying to create this effect in a web context, we will use
SVG filter effects
for our approach (step 1). What follows is that we can then easily manipulate (and therefore animate) the properties of these filter effects using JavaScript (step 2). But how do these SVG filter effects work, exactly? Let’s take a closer look.
SVG filter effects
SVG filter effects
allow us to apply various visual effects to SVG elements, such as blurring, color manipulation, and distortion. In our case, we will use a combination of the
feTurbulence
and
feDisplacementMap
filter primitives to create the boiling effect.
Conceptually, the
Turbulence Field
generates a noise texture that can be used to distort the edges of the shapes. The
Displacement Map
then uses this noise texture to displace the pixels of the original image, creating the desired distortion effect. See this visualization:
Turbulence + Displacement: How SVG filter effects work together to create the distortion effect
Additionally, I’ve created a demo that let’s you explore the interplay of these two filter effects. You can move the layers to see how the distortion changes at the intersection of the two filter effects. Note: The demo contains some added elements and visual indicators for demo purposes and easier understanding.
The above demo illustrates how the distortion effect is applied to the image. Let’s take a closer look at how to set up the SVG filter effects in terms of code.

• [nine_k] 认为该技术的效果类似于热空气扭曲，但缺乏闪烁感，更像是一种光栅效果，可能是通过GPU着色器实现的。他还提出了通过振荡节点和添加随机抖动来模拟不稳定人手效果的方法。
• [mirkodrummer] 感叹SVG有很多未被充分探索的能力，仅仅用于网页图标是一种浪费。
• [tubs] 表示该网站在手机上浏览时导致设备过热，暗示性能优化不足。
• [teeray] 提供了Squigglevision的维基百科链接作为参考。

补充讨论：
• 评论中提到了多种工具和技术的使用，如rive.app和PICO-8的Wobblepaint，显示出社区对多种工具组合应用的兴趣。
• 性能问题是讨论的一个焦点，特别是CPU和GPU的负载平衡以及在不同设备上的表现。
• 对SVG效果的实现方式和技术细节有不同的看法，如光栅效果与振荡节点的对比。
• 评论中还包含了一些幽默和轻松的元素，如"手机变成了熔岩"的夸张表达。

data.title: Staying cool without refrigerants: Next-generation Peltier cooling
data.author: simonebrunozzi
data.article_summary: 2025年7月8日，三星电子与约翰霍普金斯大学应用物理实验室（APL）在《Nature Communications》期刊上发表了一篇关于新一代Peltier冷却技术的论文。该团队利用纳米工程技术成功开发了一种高效薄膜半导体Peltier设备，实现了无制冷剂冷却，展示了在不使用传统制冷剂情况下提供卓越性能的潜力。2024年，三星通过推出Bespoke AI混合冰箱，开启了制冷技术的新篇章，该冰箱结合了Peltier设备和高效率压缩机，可智能切换冷却方式。新开发的薄膜Peltier技术代表了未来冷却技术的飞跃，提供了精确的温度控制和设计灵活性。这项创新有望应用于家用电器，并引领未来冷却技术的发展。三星的DA业务和研究部门正致力于将其整合到下一代冰箱中。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于文章中提及的AI与微控制器传感器读数，以及Peltier冷却器技术的效果和创新性的讨论。

不同观点：
• SchemaLoad和matt3210认为文章不当使用了"AI"一词，认为这只是简单的传感器读数或控制系统，与AI无关。matt3210以调侃语气指出将PID控制器称为AI是不合适的。
• BearOso和iLoveOncall同样反对将AI与冰箱技术联系在一起，认为这是不必要的术语滥用，呼吁要有基本的常识。
• fghorow和teamonkey对新技术表示关注，fghorow引用了一个帖子，指出该技术的COP（性能系数）显著高于传统压缩机冷却技术，并认为这是一个值得注意的进步。teamonkey则提供了约翰霍普金斯大学的相关新闻链接，认为该新闻稿更好。
• Havoc认为文章中提到的技术改进在于Peltier设备两端的更高效粘合，并指出75%的增益非常显著，可能涉及一些非常先进的技术。
• mark-r和anticensor则对Peltier冷却器的效率问题表示关注，认为文章没有详细说明该设备与现有Peltier冷却器的区别，并质疑是否解决了效率低下的问题。

补充讨论：
• Tistron以幽默的方式表达了对静音冰箱的期待，可能暗示对新技术在实际应用中的期望。
• 42lux和WarOnPrivacy分享了个人经历，42lux提到自己曾在14岁时用Peltier冷却器弄坏了一台AMD K6处理器，WarOnPrivacy则回忆了过去使用Peltier冷却器的经历，并对其后来的市场消失表示疑惑。
• throwaway81523对Peltier冷却器的温度降幅提出质疑，认为其实际效果不足以在炎热天气下维持冰箱温度。
• dayjah分享了在专业工作中使用Peltier加热器的经验，发现该技术在不同应用中的共通性。
• acgh213的评论似乎与主要讨论点无关，提到了色盲对颜色感知的影响。

争议焦点：
• 主要争议在于文章中将AI与简单的传感器控制技术联系在一起是否合适，多位评论者认为这是不准确且误导的。
• 另一个争议点是Peltier冷却技术的实际效果和创新性，部分评论者对其效率和应用前景持怀疑态度，而另一些人则认为其有显著的技术进步。

On June 28, Samsung Electronics, together with the Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL), published a paper on next-generation Peltier cooling technology in the prestigious scientific journal Nature Communications.
The team successfully developed a high-efficiency thin-film semiconductor Peltier device  using nano-engineering technology and demonstrated refrigerant-free cooling, highlighting the potential to deliver outstanding performance without conventional refrigerants.
Previously in 2024, Samsung Electronics opened a new chapter in refrigeration technology through the launch of the Bespoke AI Hybrid Refrigerator, which combines Peltier devices with high-efficiency compressors. Much like a hybrid vehicle, this system intelligently switches between the two cooling methods depending on what best suits the situation.
While the Bespoke AI Hybrid Refrigerator marked a major step forward, the new thin-film Peltier technology developed with Johns Hopkins APL represents a leap into the future.  How will this newly unveiled innovation be applied to home appliances, and how will it shape the cooling technology of tomorrow? To find out, Samsung Newsroom spoke with Sungjin Jung from Samsung Research, who has led the technology’s development, and Hajin Jeong from the DA (Digital Appliances) Business at Samsung Electronics, who is working to integrate it into Samsung’s next-generation refrigerators.
▲ (From left) Hajin Jeong from the Refrigerator Platform Lab of Samsung Electronics’ DA Business and Sungjin Jung from Samsung Research’s Life Solutions Team
Precise Temperature Control With Semiconductor Devices? Understanding the Principles Behind Peltier Cooling Technology
Conventional refrigerators operate using vapor compression technology. In this system, refrigerant gas is compressed into a liquid and then repeatedly evaporated to absorb and release heat, thereby lowering the internal temperature. While this widely used cooling method has proven effective, the use of refrigerants raises environmental concerns, and there are limitations in reducing power consumption — making it a challenge to carry this approach into the future and adapt it to evolving needs. Additionally, the bulky compressors and complex mechanical components inherent in this system place constraints on refrigerator design.
In contrast, Peltier cooling technology takes a different approach. As a semiconductor-based method that uses electricity to transfer heat, Peltier cooling utilizes the Peltier effect, in which an electric current passing through both ends of a Peltier device  causes one side to absorb heat while the other side releases it.
▲The Peltier effect
Utilizing the Peltier effect, the surface that absorbs heat and cools can be placed inside the refrigerator, while the surface that releases the absorbed heat can be positioned outside — effectively lowering the internal temperature. The greatest advantage of this method is its precise control of heat flow using only electricity. In addition, its simple structure compared to refrigerant-based mechanical systems allows for greater flexibility in refrigerator design.
Advancing Peltier Technology and Expanding Possibilities Through Global Collaboration
In early 2023, Samsung Electronics ramped up cross-organizational collaboration — bringing together the DA Business, Samsung Research and Global Technology Research — to commercialize Peltier cooling technology and enhance its performance. The DA Business primarily focused on Peltier-technology-based product development, leading to the launch of the Bespoke AI Hybrid Refrigerator in early 2024. Samsung Research and Global Technology Research, meanwhile, drove technological advancement by developing high-performance Peltier devices with improved output and durability.
Around the same time, Samsung Research also initiated global collaboration efforts to pursue breakthroughs in fundamental technologies. In late 2023, it partnered with Johns Hopkins APL in the United States eventually launching an eight-month-long full-scale joint research project in April the following year.

data.title: Stdio(3) change: FILE is now opaque (OpenBSD)
data.author: gslin
data.article_summary: 2025年7月17日，OpenBSD的-current分支中，stdio(3)的FILE类型结构体被设为不透明（opaque），相关库版本也已更新。具体改动包括将__sFILE定义移至libc/hidden/_stdio.h，并暂时保留某些符号以方便过渡，但这些符号将很快被删除。这一重大变更影响了许多系统组件，建议从源代码构建的用户使用快照升级以顺利过渡。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：C标准库中`FILE`类型及其相关标准流（stdin, stdout, stderr）的变更及其影响

不同观点：
• JdeBP认为，对标准流（stdin, stdout, stderr）的更改是主要的破坏性变化，尤其是当这些流从数组元素变为命名指针时，可能会导致未重新编译的代码无法链接。他提到了Plauger示例实现中的历史做法，并指出这种变化在当前情境中已经发生。

• loeg指出，FreeBSD曾尝试将`FILE`变为不透明类型，但该更改被回退，目前在主分支中仍是非不透明状态。他提供了相关的提交链接以支持其观点。

• Cadwhisker认为，评论中缺少对更改原因的解释，并询问该更改是否出于安全原因或为未来变化做准备。

• abnercoimbre表示，他一直将`FILE`视为不透明类型，但没想到有人会深入探究其内部结构，并请求进一步解释。

• cperciva补充，非不透明`FILE`允许代码兼容那些将`FILE`放入结构体的做法，因为不透明`FILE`没有大小。

• p0w3n3d质疑依赖`FILE`内部结构的做法是否是不良实践，认为这不应该被鼓励。

• xpressvideoz抱怨在提交信息和公告文章中未提及更改的基本原理，对此表示担忧。

• notepad0x90对OpenBSD勇于改变的态度表示赞赏，并认为Linux应从中学习，同时提到Windows因不愿打破旧有兼容性而带来的问题。

• somat享受OpenBSD与Linux在ABI变更处理上的对比，指出Linux在ABI变更上的困难和复杂性，部分原因是闭源软件的兼容性问题。

• quotemstr提到CHERI架构可以通过防御对内部数据结构的访问，而无需在地址空间之间跳转。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于将`FILE`变为不透明类型是否必要及其影响，特别是对现有代码的兼容性问题。
• 讨论中多次提及更改的基本原理不明，显示出对透明性和沟通的关注。
• 不同操作系统（如OpenBSD和Linux）在处理ABI变更上的策略和挑战也被对比讨论。

Added files:
lib/libc/hidden: _stdio.h
lib/libc/stdio : fdclose.c
Log message:
Make the FILE object opaque.  Move the __sFILE definition into
libc/hidden/_stdio.h.  All programs that refer to the internal
structure of the FILE object can't be compiled from now on.
std{in,out,err} doesn't refer __sF[] now, but the hidden __sF along
with __srget and __swbuf symbols are kept temporarily to make our
transition easier.  But those symbols will be deleted soon.  The shared
library versions are bumped for libc and all the other libraries that
refer to std{in,out,err}.
diff from guenther, tweak by me, tested by many
ok sthen tb
Make no mistake, this is a
major
change, which touches a lot of components across the base system. The fallout can be seen in a lot of places, including
libcrypto
(which is itself subject to a major, sepearate cleanup),
libtls
,
libssl
, and includes touches to the
profiling subsystem
we
mentioned earlier
.
Those who normally build from source are
strongly
encouraged
to use a snapshot upgrade
to cross the bumps.

data.article_summary: 这篇文章讨论了通过刺激视网膜上的视锥细胞来体验新颜色的可能性。人类眼睛有三种视锥细胞（S、M、L），它们对不同波长的光敏感，但由于光谱重叠，无法单独激活某一种细胞。研究人员使用激光脉冲选择性地刺激单个视锥细胞，使实验对象看到了前所未有的高饱和蓝绿色。文章还提到了一种通过视觉错觉体验新颜色的方法，即利用动画使红色锥细胞饱和，从而观察到异常强烈的蓝绿色。文章最后讨论了技术上使用sRGB颜色空间显示颜色的局限性，指出其无法完全呈现人眼能感知的所有颜色。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：色觉、色彩错觉的原理及其在不同人群中的表现差异，以及技术实现的限制和扩展。

不同观点：
• [georgecmu] 解释了色觉的演化背景，尤其是人类和灵长类动物中三色视觉的演化过程。他认为，由于基因复制事件，旧世界灵长类动物演化出了第三种视锥细胞，而新世界灵长类动物则通过多态性视锥基因实现了部分个体的三色视觉。他还提到，色盲在男性中更常见是因为相关基因位于X染色体上。

• [TheAceOfHearts] 分享了个人体验，描述了观看色彩错觉时的主观感受，认为这是一种非常愉快的体验，但对技术原理未作深入讨论。

• [peterisza] 提出透明度的演化与生物对电磁波谱可见光部分敏感性的关系，认为生物进化使得我们对特定波段的光敏感，这部分与主话题稍有偏离。

• [weinzierl] 讨论了色盲人群在色彩错觉中的体验差异，特别是异常三色视觉者和二色视觉者的区别。他认为，某些色盲类型（如原形和 deutan 类型）的差异在于视锥细胞的响应波长不同，并提出这种错觉现象可能用于色盲测试。

• [blincoln] 分享了自己对色彩组合的意外体验，预期与实际看到的颜色不同，感到困惑，并对色彩错觉的机制提出疑问。

• [perching_aix] 表示自己无法重现所述的色彩错觉效果，反而看到了不同的颜色（橙色），并对色彩背景的真实颜色进行了验证。

• [kadoban] 关注色盲人群是否能体验到色彩错觉，并提出是否能针对色盲类型设计特定的错觉效果，或者该概念是否由于色盲者眼睛的特殊性而无法实现。

• [ComplexSystems] 对技术实现提出批评，认为自定义色彩选择的功能有限，无法输入任意RGB颜色，并对文章宣传和实际功能之间的落差表示不满。

• [armchairhacker] 从色彩错觉的实现方式引申到生活哲理，认为通过简单的方法（如错觉）实现复杂效果是一种智慧，同时也指出更复杂的技术（如激光刺激）在科研中的价值。

• [_Microft] 分享了增强色彩错觉效果的技巧，即通过多次刷新页面来延长体验时间。

• [sampl3username] 提到了使用迷幻药物（如LSD）也能看到日常生活中不常见的饱和色彩，将话题引向化学诱导的色彩体验。

• [rezmason] 表达了对特定波长（460nm）显示器的需求，可能与色彩显示技术相关，但与主讨论点稍有偏离。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于色盲人群是否能体验到色彩错觉效果。weinzierl 和 kadoban 提出了不同看法，前者认为部分色盲类型可能仍能体验到效果，而后者则质疑是否能针对色盲者设计专用效果。
• 对技术实现的批评主要集中在色彩选择的自由度上，ComplexSystems 认为功能有限，无法满足自定义需求。
• 部分评论者分享了个人主观体验，如 TheAceOfHearts 和 blincoln，提供了不同视角下的色彩错觉感受。
• 讨论还涉及到色觉演化和生物学基础，特别是 georgecmu 提供的背景信息，丰富了对色觉演化过程的理解。
